experiment_log.name: ABMIL (CNN baseline)
experiment_log.notes: Standard ABMIL, CNN encoder. 10 epochs, batch_size=32.

experiment_log.name: Sparse ABMIL (main, lambda=3.0)
experiment_log.notes: Main model. 10 epochs. Best test_acc=0.9872 at epoch 6. Final model uses lambda_rule=3.0 (selected after full fine-grained sweep 0.1-3.0). Epoch 9 checkpoint, test_acc=0.9866, Spearman=0.7037.

experiment_log.name: Rules-only baseline
experiment_log.notes: Keyword matching + regex patterns, no model training.

experiment_log.name: 3x Ablation evaluation
experiment_log.notes: Loaded existing checkpoints (epoch 8-9) and evaluated with new 4 metrics.

experiment_log.name: BERT-ABMIL
experiment_log.notes: Frozen DistilBERT encoder. 10 epochs. Best test_acc=0.9801 at epoch 8. HuggingFace download timeout on tokenizer (~1 min delay).

experiment_log.name: Snorkel
experiment_log.notes: Label Model + CNN classifier. 10 epochs. Fixed: (1) tokenization bug - now uses pre-tokenized tokens; (2) continuous pseudo-probs for MSE regression instead of binary thresholding; (3) keywords path bug in evaluation (was resolving to wrong directory, Spearman was incorrectly 0.0, actual Spearman=0.6001).

experiment_log.name: AI2TALE (PyTorch) - Attempt 1
experiment_log.notes: Failed: import path error (ai2tale_src.ai2tale vs ai2tale).

experiment_log.name: AI2TALE (PyTorch) - Attempt 2
experiment_log.notes: Failed: KL divergence tensor dimension mismatch (n_valid > S). Fixed with min(n_valid, S).

experiment_log.name: AI2TALE (PyTorch) - Attempt 3
experiment_log.notes: Failed: NaN loss despite soft Gumbel-Softmax. Converged to random (acc=0.5000). Needs further debugging.

experiment_log.name: Lambda sweep (coarse)
experiment_log.notes: 5 configs: lambda=0.1(156min), 0.3(66min), 0.5(21min), 1.0(21min), 2.0(21min). Coarse sweep suggested lambda~2.0.

experiment_log.name: Self-Training (5 rounds)
experiment_log.notes: Pseudo-label iteration. No improvement in Spearman (0.459 -> 0.458). Entropy increased 0.83->1.15 (more diffuse attention).

experiment_log.name: Lambda sweep (fine)
experiment_log.notes: 19 configs: lambda=1.1 to 3.0 step 0.1, plus coarse configs. Full range 0.1-3.0 reveals bimodal trend: local peak at 1.6 (0.663), global peak at 3.0 (0.704). F1 remains >0.98 across all configs. Sparse ABMIL main model updated to lambda=3.0.

experiment_log.name: AI2TALE (PyTorch) - Attempt 5 (soft selection)
experiment_log.notes: Complete rewrite: plain softmax (no Gumbel), entropy regularization instead of KL, NaN batch skipping. 10 epochs completed without NaN. Best test_acc=0.9910 at epoch 10. Results: AUPRC=0.5459, F1=0.3280, Spearman=0.3585, Entropy=1.4691. Classification and localization both poor - soft selection converges to diffuse attention.

lambda_sweep_fine.trend: Bimodal trend: local peak at λ=1.6 (0.663), global peak at λ=3.0 (0.704). F1 stable >0.98 across all configs. Sparse ABMIL main model uses λ=3.0.
